main.title: Anthropic Shares Jump 34% After $107.3 Billion IPO Breaks Record
main.summary: Anthropic PBC shares opened 34% above their IPO price after the artificial intelligence lab’s blockbuster $107.3 billion debut broke SpaceX’s record for the biggest-ever offering.

related.title: Anthropic valued at $2tn as shares surge 34% as trading begins – business live
related.summary: Rolling coverage of Anthropic’s IPO, and the latest economic and financial news Anthropic to begin public trading at $1.5tn valuation after largest ever IPO Outages, spies, and trillion-dollar IPOs: is this our AI future? – Stateside with Kai and Carter Anthropic needs to grow into its $1.5tn valuation, argues Kathleen Brooks, research director at XTB: Anthropic’s triumphant IPO and its trillion dollar plus valuation is more typical of a mature company that has a history of strong fundamentals.

180226c62f.topic: IPO record di Anthropic, +34% al debutto, valutazione 2.000 miliardi
180226c62f.reason: È la più grande IPO della storia: ha superato il record di SpaceX e il titolo ha aperto in rialzo del 34%. Ne parlano quasi tutte le testate principali, è un banco di prova per la fiducia dei mercati sull'AI e non l'abbiamo ancora trattata.

main.title: Europe ready for talks with Russia on ending war in Ukraine, leaders say
main.summary: European allies of Ukraine say they have a "united" negotiating position at a summit in Berlin.

related.title: European leaders reject 'Yalta 2.0' for Ukraine after Trump meets Putin and Xi
related.summary: "A Yalta format will not bring peace," German Chancellor Friedrich Merz said at the end of a Coalition of the Willing meeting in Berlin just hours after Trump, Putin and Xi held talks in China.

related.title: Trump questions Europe's billions in Ukraine aid during surprise call
related.summary: The US president reportedly called into a meeting of Kyiv's European allies from Air Force One, hours after talks with Putin and Xi, and said Moscow was ready to negotiate a peace deal.

210030c7cf.topic: Volenterosi a Berlino: Europa pronta a trattare con la Russia sull'Ucraina
210030c7cf.reason: Dopo il vertice di Shenzhen, l'Europa (Italia compresa, con Meloni e il formato E5) si presenta unita e pronta a trattare con Mosca. Putin invita i leader europei e Trump contesta gli aiuti a Kiev: è uno sviluppo nuovo, ripreso da molte testate autorevoli.
